---
title: "Reproduce camtrapReport outputs"
output:
  html_document:
    mathjax: null
---

This workflow regenerates the configured ecological and/or data-status reports
from the accompanying saved object. It preserves stored inputs, selected modules,
text, settings and model caches. It does not rebuild the object from raw data.
See `README.md` and `sessionInfo.txt` for dependencies and limitations.

The same `reproduce.R` script used at the command line runs in a separate R
process, avoiding nested report rendering and changes to this session.

```{r reproduce, echo=TRUE}
script <- file.path(dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)), "reproduce.R")
if (!file.exists(script)) stop("Keep reproduce.R beside reproduce.Rmd.")
log <- system2(file.path(R.home("bin"), "Rscript"),
               c("--vanilla", shQuote(normalizePath(script, winslash = "/"))),
               stdout = TRUE, stderr = TRUE)
cat(paste(log, collapse = "\n"))
if (!is.null(attr(log, "status")) && attr(log, "status") != 0L) {
  stop("Report reproduction failed; see the output above.")
}
```

Outputs are saved below `reports/`. Further runs use `reports/run-001/`, etc.,
without replacing earlier reports. Rendering this document again replaces only
its ordinary R Markdown summary (`reproduce.html`).
